steps.title: Find your product
steps.text: Browse a category or search by product name. Open the listing to compare available photos and the estimated USD price.

steps.title: Check the details
steps.text: Review the original seller, measurements, colour and quantity. Product photos help you research; they do not confirm stock or the condition of your order.

steps.title: Continue on OOPBuy
steps.text: Open the product in OOPBuy and confirm the loaded item, variant and current price. Manage payment, order photos and shipping in your official account.

faq.q: Is OOPBuy Tab the official OOPBuy website?
faq.a: OOPBuy Tab is an independent product discovery site. Registration, orders and payments take place on oopbuy.com. Purchase links include an affiliate invite code; no discount is promised.

faq.q: Where do the products and prices come from?
faq.a: Product listings, images, search results and sorting come from CNBuyCha. Prices are displayed in USD across all languages. Confirm the current price, availability and selected variant in OOPBuy.

faq.q: Are the product photos warehouse QC photos?
faq.a: The displayed images come from CNBuyCha. Their origin as warehouse QC is not verified. Check the photos of your own order in OOPBuy before deciding to ship.

faq.q: Does the item price include delivery?
faq.a: Treat the displayed amount as an estimated item price. Review domestic postage, international delivery, optional services and any applicable charges in the current checkout and parcel quote.

faq.q: How do the purchase links work?
faq.a: The button on a product page opens its original Weidian item ID in OOPBuy. The CNBuyCha catalogue number is a separate ID. Check the destination listing before you order.

faq.q: Can I search with an image?
faq.a: Image search is not available in this preview. You can search by name or browse the categories. We do not substitute unrelated results for an uploaded photo.

articles.title: Your first OOPBuy find, step by step
articles.description: Turn a promising listing into a considered choice.

sections.title: Start with what you need
sections.text: Choose a category or search for a model. Compare the product name, available pictures and estimated price. A low price alone cannot tell you whether a listing matches your needs.

sections.title: Open the original listing
sections.text: Check the seller and available options. Note the size, colour and quantity you want, then open the product in OOPBuy. Confirm those details again before paying.

sections.title: Keep the next stage in mind
sections.text: Allow room in your budget for delivery and other charges. Review your own order photos and the available shipping quote before submitting a parcel.

articles.title: What to look for in product and QC photos
articles.description: Separate catalogue research from checks of your own order.

sections.title: Know which photos you are viewing
sections.text: Catalogue pictures show a listing; they are not proof of the item you will receive. The photos on OOPBuy Tab are supplied by CNBuyCha and are not verified as warehouse QC.

sections.title: Compare specific details
sections.text: For your own order, compare the model, colour, visible size label and quantity with what you selected. Look for obvious damage and ask about unclear details before shipping.

sections.title: Understand the limits
sections.text: Photos alone cannot establish authenticity, durability or full working condition. If you need a measurement or an extra inspection, ask OOPBuy what is available and what it costs.

articles.title: The item price is only the beginning
articles.description: A clearer way to plan your parcel budget.

sections.title: Separate the costs
sections.text: Keep the product price, seller-to-warehouse postage and international delivery separate in your budget. Check optional services and payment-related charges in the current quote.

sections.title: Use your actual parcel details
sections.text: Enter your destination, weight, dimensions and goods type in the official estimator. Compare the restrictions and billing rules of eligible routes. An estimate is not a final invoice.

sections.title: Choose packaging deliberately
sections.text: Packaging affects protection and parcel size. Ask how removing or reinforcing packaging changes the quote and protection before confirming. Keep track of each item's storage deadline in your account.

articles.title: A better size check starts at home
articles.description: Compare measurements instead of relying on a familiar label.

sections.title: Measure something that fits
sections.text: Choose a similar item you already own. For clothing, record the relevant flat measurements; for shoes, use the seller's measurement method. Keep the units consistent.

sections.title: Read the exact listing
sections.text: Size labels can differ between sellers and models. Compare your measurements with the chart for the exact item. Check whether a figure is a flat width, a circumference or a length.

sections.title: Resolve uncertainty early
sections.text: Ask about unclear measurements before ordering. If you need additional measurements from your order, confirm service availability and cost. No single size chart can guarantee fit.

articles.title: One product, two different IDs
articles.description: Why the seller item ID matters when opening a find.

sections.title: A catalogue number identifies the page
sections.text: CNBuyCha gives each product page its own catalogue number. That number is useful within the catalogue, but it is not necessarily the seller's item ID.

sections.title: The seller link identifies the item
sections.text: For a Weidian listing, the purchase button uses the item ID from its original seller URL. It opens that item in OOPBuy with this site's affiliate invite code.

sections.title: Check the page after opening
sections.text: Compare the title, seller and variant with the listing you researched. If the page has changed or is unavailable, return to the catalogue and choose another listing deliberately.

articles.title: Compare the same thing, not just the price
articles.description: A small checklist for comparing two promising finds.

sections.title: Match the options
sections.text: Compare the same size, colour, quantity and included accessories. The lowest displayed price may refer to a different option from the one you want.

sections.title: Include the next costs
sections.text: Compare domestic postage and the likely parcel requirements alongside the item price. Confirm the final payment breakdown in OOPBuy rather than treating a catalogue estimate as a quote.

sections.title: Keep a record
sections.text: Save the original seller link and the options you selected. Those details help you compare your order photos and explain a mismatch if you need support.
